//: Base spellcheck policy for governed documentation (DOC-0022). Lives centrally per ADR-0081: shared logic and policy here, per-repository data in the repo. A repo MAY add cspell-words.txt at the docs_root it invokes the workflow with (not necessarily the repo root) for terms genuinely specific to it; the workflow then generates a config that imports this one and registers that file as a dictionary. Anything platform-wide belongs in dictionaries/platform.txt so one word is not whitelisted twelve times.

dictionaryDefinitions.name: platform
dictionaryDefinitions.description: Shared platform vocabulary: service names, protocols, infrastructure and provider terms.

//ignorePaths: Generated artifacts and vendored trees are not authored prose. `.core-docs` is a vendored copy of another namespace and is spellchecked in its own repository, not twice.
//ignoreRegExpList: Regions that are identifiers rather than prose. Spellchecking them produces noise no author can act on, and the identifiers themselves are already governed by DOC-0013..DOC-0018.
